text:
Samir: PartnerX reported missing hourly heartbeats this week (~0.15% rows). Causes under-credited usage. Thoughts: reconstruct vs SLA exemption?
Alyssa: No SLA exemption for partner bugs. Prefer best-effort reconstruction + clear flag for CS.
Miguel: Agreed. Avoid retro credits unless we can prove intent/volume. Can we infer usage from cumulative counters on the next heartbeat?
Jordan: PartnerX often sends a cumulative total_usage on resume. If gap <= 4h and next_total > prev_total, split delta evenly across missing hours and mark as inferred.
Maria: Must keep audit trail and separate ingestion tag so billing can QA. CS needs visibility before auto-credit.
partner-billing-bot: Alert: PartnerX missing heartbeats 2026-03-20T03:00Z -> 2026-03-20T06:00Z (3h). Resume signature valid.
Samir: Proposal: per-partner policy {max_infer_gap_hours:4, min_delta_threshold:1000, mark_inferred:true}. Only infer if delta >= threshold.
Alyssa: Run a 2-week dry-run: create inferred rows in staging, surface to dashboards and CS, but don't auto-credit. After signoff enable credits.
Miguel: Quick detection SQL ready; will implement dry-run ingestion path and idempotent materialization.
Jordan: For idempotency include source_tag like inferred_v1_partnerx + original_window_hash. I'll add dashboard tile "inferred credits % by partner" and an alert.
Maria: Ops: add alert when inferred > 0.5% of daily usage for a partner, and a CS runbook for escalation. I'll coordinate partner comms and hold manual crediting until signoff.
Alyssa: Also add sku_exclude list in policy so trial SKUs aren't inferred.
Miguel: Will include sku_exclude and policy UI hooks. ETA: end of next week for staging dry-run.
partner-billing-bot: Created issue PB-482: partnerx-inference-dryrun.
Samir: Rollout plan recap: 1) staging dry-run 2) 14-day dry-run + dashboards/CS review 3) agree threshold with PartnerX 4) enable auto-credit + daily audit. Reconvene after dry-run. :thumbsup:
